narration: Welcome to the Arms & Armour gallery. This is a 17th‑century dagger from Udaipur, Rajasthan, measuring about 40 centimeters long. Its blade is plain, but the hilt is shaped like a ram and studded with lustrous precious stones, a motif that was popular in the royal workshops of the Rajput courts. The dagger is sheathed in a beautifully decorated leather scabbard, typical of the fine courtly weaponry produced in Udaipur. This piece, accessioned as 59.1/2, reflects the blend of functional design and ceremonial elegance that defined Rajput arms.
